subject: quick feedback? trip chaos
text:
Hi there,

So, quick favor if you have a second. I’m still putting together the little landing page for the pottery studio, and I’d love your eyes on it before I send it out. The trip threw everything off, of course. My flight got delayed, then canceled, then rebooked, and now my suitcase is playing hard to get. I’m fine, just operating on airport snacks and stubbornness.

Anyway, what I really need is the blunt take: does the first screen make the schedule confusing, or does it look okay on a phone? I’m trying to decide whether to cut the class list down or add a tiny FAQ. Be rough if you want. I won’t cry, probably.

Really, though, thanks a ton.
